scope: replay the session-stable body from offset 10
conclusion: dropping the ten contaminated bytes and replaying from the stable 03 header still does not get acknowledged

interpretation.the_03_is_not_enough: 03 followed by four zeros is stable across sessions, but on its own it does not make the packet a valid server message; either the real opcode lives inside the contaminated prefix, or the 03 is not an opcode at all
what_we_know_for_certain: delivery to ring B works (13/13 counters)
the cipher key challenge^seq is correct (map name decodes)
the map name and serverinfo text are real and byte-exact
the prefix of ten bytes varies with the session key and is therefore cipher-side, not content

alternative_approaches: stop replaying and instead instrument the dedrun to dump the plaintext buffer right before SV_Netchan_Encode is called - that removes the prefix ambiguity completely
or bypass the wrapper question by having the dedrun itself send our content: patch its reliableCommands entry text and let its own encoder frame it
or accept a longer path: finish a source-level server (needs a compiler) where the framing is known by construction
